reader.requirement: At --std 85 every data-name operand of LINAGE (page body, FOOTING, TOP, BOTTOM), qualified or not, must be refused unless it references an elementary unsigned numeric integer data item: a group, a non-numeric (alphanumeric, numeric-edited) item, an index item, a fractional item and a signed item are each refused at compile time.

adjudication.reason: THE COMPILER CRASHES ON LEGAL SOURCE. A level 66 item that renames one elementary item, named as FILE STATUS, LINAGE, DEPENDING ON, RELATIVE KEY or a report CONTROL, ends the compiler with an unhandled `System.InvalidOperationException` ("no Place was built for data item"), at 85 and at 2023, with no COBOL diagnostic. Each use is legal: "all of the data attributes of data-name-2 become the data attributes for data-name-1" (`§1985:VI.5.11.4 GR2`). I ran the FILE STATUS case. Not probed: SORT and MERGE keys, SUM operands, RECORD KEY. For `1985-SR-XIII.3.7.3-2` the row's own check is right for every operand that compiles.
